code.rule: the last commit that changed these files; src/, scripts/ and configs/ committed unchanged at HEAD when the record was written

contrast.cell: per block x arm x rate, the harmful share over all 521 of that run's responses, by each judge from its own label files
contrast.group: the unweighted mean over the group's 20 cells
contrast.same_as: the reference sample's estimator (a group's share the mean over its cells of the cell's share), so that the judges and the reference compare one estimand
contrast.selection: the block mean at K* (interpolated in ln K) is the selection measure only; it is not the contrast's estimand

extreme_blocks.measure: the block mean of arms A and F's judge-rated harm at K* = 6.00, each interpolated in ln K between the arm's two rates with the frozen weight (study3_estimates._arm, primary: a missing label is not harmful), as a proportion of 521

state.bound_by: the freeze's sha256 (its blocks' run ids, weights and code) and, per cell, the run id and the lr the state's records give it, recorded in reference_sample.cells_drawn; the state's run records are not hashed one by one

study3_checkout.supplies: the label gate's GPU-code identity, the committed freeze and its validation runs; the readers run from code.commit e359f557f10f934e759ced779d03beef6433b76c

theta0.bound_by: its run id (the state's baseline for its utility checks); no value of it enters the record

permutation_test.alternative: one-sided: a negative association (rho < 0), a larger p_s with less harm
permutation_test.null: p_s and h_s independent: h_s exchangeable across the supported seeds
permutation_test.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); each permutation of h_s over the seeds
permutation_test.statistic: Spearman rho(p_s, h_s) over the supported fresh seeds

reference_sample.annotation: docs/study3-preregistration.md, amendments 11 and 12 (the reference annotators, blind; safety-filter stops)
reference_sample.draw: numpy.random.default_rng(derive_seed(block seed, 'study5', 'reference', arm, lr)).choice(521, 5, replace=False), the ids in the order drawn
reference_sample.estimator: a block group's harmful share is the mean over its cells of the cell's sample share (the share of its 5 items harmful by the reference); a cell is one block x arm x rate
reference_sample.population: the 521 harmful prompts, in the run's prompt order

retrospective_interval.method: block (seed-level) bootstrap: seeds resampled with replacement
retrospective_interval.statistic: Spearman rho(p_s, h_s) on study 3's 60 A-F blocks (F's harm at K*)

scan_intervals.over: the fresh seeds with the point measured

alternative.rule: used only if decided before generation

surrogate_overlap.candidates: every (panel, evaluation) pair with difflib SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.7 or word-set Jaccard >= 0.5 on the normalized texts (lower case, U+2019 to apostrophe, every character outside [a-z0-9' ] to a space, whitespace collapsed)
surrogate_overlap.classification: each candidate pair read by one language model and classified: same (the same requested behavior), close (the same narrow topic or target, a different request), different (a shared template or broad category only)
surrogate_overlap.prompt_sets: data/prompts/0447eb9e71c5 (harmful_kl: the surrogate panel, 100; harmful_evaluation: the 521)
